column1: # Authored expectation for the Phase-19 test-surface join.
# Section S clause 2: the run enumerates its test surfaces and joins them completely to an
# owner is the registry the ids are enumerated from at run time:
#   items     the validation-locus entries and mutant names the run read
#   checks    the check ids tools/ui_program_schema_gate.py implements
# The 30 items are partitioned so each is claimed exactly once. Several foreclosure surfaces
# take both a negative fixture and the mutant that attacks the same foreclosure — the bound
# check and its `M-drop-bound-check` mutant, exhaustiveness and `M-skip-exhaustiveness`,
# port unification and `M-swap-port-contract` — because a foreclosure is only evidenced by
# both halves: the negative that must fail, and the mutant proving the check has teeth.
# `runtime-noninterference` carries no id: it is a runtime property this pure register
# cannot reach, and no observation stands behind it here.
